eve.text: Glen Elendra is the secluded haven where Oona is reborn in secret after Maralen deals her the killing blow with moonglove, following Oona's killing of the Sapling of Colfenor, whose poison Rhys absorbs. Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.

Maralen gives Rhys the moonglove and instructs him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return, and Rhys is granted eternal life until he can fulfill his oath. Oko manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, and Rhys moves to strike her.
